#21 Reconnect dropped Modbus clients [OPEN]
https://github.com/o/r/issues/21
by someone

**Status** in progress · **Lane** full

## Goal
A client tab reconnects on its own after the server drops the connection.
Today the user restarts the tab by hand.

## Requirements
- **R1** A TCP client whose connection drops without a user disconnect enters the reconnecting state.

## Scenarios
- **S1** — Server restarts during polling
  - Given a client tab polling a TCP server
  - When the server closes the connection
  - Then the tab shows "reconnecting" and polling resumes once the server is back
